definitions.gloss: spring tide; exceptionally high and low tides
definitions.explanation: The tides that occur around new moon and full moon when the gravitational pull of the sun and moon align, producing the largest tidal range. The opposite of neap tide.

examples.japanese: ⟦{明日|あした}→明日：00501_ashita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大潮|おおしお}だ。
{大潮|おおしお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{最適|さいてき}→最適：13010_saiteki⟧だ。
examples.english: Spring tide days are ideal for clam digging.

examples.japanese: {大潮|おおしお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海面|かいめん}→海面：15838_kaimen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{普段|ふだん}→普段：00041_fudan⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{上下|じょうげ}する→上下する：20079_jougesuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: During spring tides, the sea level rises and falls more than usual, so fishing conditions change.

notes:
An important concept for fishing, coastal activities, and traditional Japanese life. Spring tides occur roughly twice a month, around the ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧ (new moon) and ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧ (full moon). Composed of {大|おお} (big/great) + ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧ (tide).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大潮|おおしお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧: spring tide day
- {大潮|おおしお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧: spring tide period
- {大潮|おおしお}⟦{満潮|まんちょう}→満潮：06530_manchou⟧: high water at spring tide
- {大潮|おおしお}⟦{干潮|かんちょう}→干潮：06531_kanchou⟧: low water at spring tide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {小潮|こしお}: neap tide — the opposite, with the smallest tidal range, occurring at quarter moons
- ⟦{満潮|まんちょう}→満潮：06530_manchou⟧: high tide — the peak water level, regardless of whether it is a spring or neap tide
- ⟦{干潮|かんちょう}→干潮：06531_kanchou⟧: low tide — the lowest water level
- ⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧: tide — the general word for tides

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese fishing calendars and tide tables ({潮見表|しおみひょう}) prominently mark {大潮|おおしお} days, as many fish are more active during spring tides. ⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧ (clam digging at low tide) is a popular spring activity best done during {大潮|おおしお}.
